credentials.scope: Fine-grained GitHub PAT or GitHub App installation token scoped to one target repository and the minimum Issues/Pull requests permissions required by github-mcp.
credentials.env_location: operator/deployment secret store injected into the worker environment only; never committed to repo files, logs, events, dashboard payloads, snapshots, or artifacts

rotation.verification: run uv run python scripts/check_production_credentials.py and a github-mcp absent/bogus-token smoke test before enabling real writes

revocation.verification: remove or revoke the token at the provider, clear the deployment secret, restart/recheck consumers, and confirm github-mcp fails closed without GITHUB_MCP_SCOPED_TOKEN

scanner_coverage: git ls-files -z | xargs -0 uv run secret-hygiene-precommit

audit_event.behavior: runtime consumers must emit metadata-only secret.accessed events for credential reads before production activation; emitted payloads must include secret_name and scope only, never credential values
